benefits.title: Natural
benefits.intro: Experience the comforting goodness of Gyani Tea, crafted to bring rich flavour, refreshing aroma, and warmth to your everyday moments. A freshly brewed cup of tea can help you feel refreshed, provide a gentle boost of alertness through its natural caffeine content, and make your daily tea ritual more enjoyable. Made for those who appreciate authentic taste and the simple pleasure of a perfectly brewed cup, Gyani Tea brings comfort and freshness to every sip.

items.title: Rich in Antioxidants
items.desc: Potent catechins and polyphenols guard vitality, shield cells, and support daily cellular wellness.

items.title: Supports Calm Focus
items.desc: Natural L-theanine provides sustained, clean mental clarity without caffeine spikes or crashes.

items.title: Naturally Refreshing
items.desc: Pure whole leaves and botanicals for rejuvenating hydration and crisp aromatic revitalization.

collection.title: Loose Leaf Collection
collection.asideDesc: Whole-leaf integrity preserves essential oils and delicate aromas that commercial tea dust destroys.

blends.title: Signature Blends
blends.subtitle: Thoughtfully crafted. Naturally better. Discover our most loved blends made with sun-dried herbs and wild mountain spices.

items.name: Citrus Green
items.notes: Crisp Sencha green leaves with dried bergamot peel, lemongrass, and bright morning citrus zest.

items.name: Mint Garden
items.notes: Cool Moroccan spearmint, peppermint leaves, sweet licorice root, and soothing elderflower.

items.name: Golden Chai
items.notes: Rich Assam CTC black tea, freshly crushed green cardamom, Ceylon cinnamon, and aromatic cloves.

createBlend.title: Create Your Blend
createBlend.subtitle: Your tea. Your way. A customized cup as unique and personal as your morning ritual.

steps.title: Pick a base
steps.desc: Choose from delicate green, bold Assam black, earthy oolong, or caffeine-free South African rooibos.

steps.title: Add a flavor
steps.desc: Infuse with dried orange peel, cardamom pods, cinnamon bark, lavender blossoms, or fresh mint.

steps.title: Choose format
steps.desc: Packaged in vacuum-sealed biodegradable pyramid silk sachets or loose leaf tin containers.
